note: What each PUBLISHED IMAGE supports — its own plate solve, its own bodies in frame, whether it can be placed on the sky, its close-up, its confirmed Wikipedia article, and the id a vote for it carries. The gallery renders a control if and only if the record for the image ON SCREEN says it is supported; it does not project, infer, or fall back to a sibling photograph. Written by tools/build_capabilities.py. Keyed by ORIGINAL path; publish.py rewrites the keys to the published paths, as it does for photo_options.json.
